title: The Gambia Country Climate and Development Report
temporal_coverage: Historical climate and agricultural trends; modelled poverty effects to 2050; climate scenarios through the second half of the century
methodology: CCDR combines climate projections with economic, poverty, and development analysis.
limitations: Rainfall projections are indicative; poverty modelling omits some non-labour and disaster-asset effects.

title: The Gambia Floods Rapid Needs Assessment Report
organization: United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA), with UNDAC and national counterparts
temporal_coverage: Floods of July–August 2022; assessment published January 2023
methodology: Rapid needs assessment drawing on national disaster-management data, a perception survey, and secondary-source review.
limitations: Affected and displaced counts are assessment estimates; the inspected report does not attribute the floods to climate change.

title: The Gambia Second Nationally Determined Contribution
temporal_coverage: National climate vulnerability and policy document; dated 2021
methodology: Government NDC describing national climate vulnerabilities and commitments.
limitations: The cited passage is a qualitative national assessment and does not quantify the exposed population or attribute specific impacts.
